verdict.rationale: The private equity practice page says the firm's support runs through to "exits", including buyouts and going-private transactions. That page also cites a USD 1.6B acquisition deal, and the homepage lists start-ups and VC funds as clients. However, nothing ties this exit work specifically to venture-backed companies, and no public-offering experience appears anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: a dedicated M&A practice page, IPO/capital-markets experience, venture-backed exit case studies, independent corroboration.
